name: RetroGemini Self-Hosted
free_limit: Unrestricted self-hosted Scrum retrospective boards, team health checks and collaboration; no software usage quota or expiry published.
watch_out: Bring your own server and persistent SQLite/PostgreSQL storage; configure HTTPS and stable session secret for production. Optional SMTP, Jira and AI integrations may cost extra. Render demo uses ephemeral storage and is not a durable free hosted plan.
